summary: Removes the agents submodule (worktree, index, .gitmodules, and .git/modules) and rewrites the Primary instructions section to require a global agents-install of a separate clone. git submodule status is empty and no submodule.agents config remains; bootstrap.ps1 never cloned recursively and install.ps1 only walks extensions/, so neither needed a change. Markdown checker reports no errors on either file.

improvements.text: The install snippet clones into the current directory, so where the clone lives is left to the reader.
improvements.recommendation: Left deliberately: the clone location is the user machine owner decision and agents-install records whatever path it is run from.

positives.text: CLAUDE.md was updated alongside AGENTS.md, so neither file still points at the removed REPO/agents path.

verdict.rationale: Documentation-only change beyond the submodule removal; no critical or high findings.
